items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: That was the greatest band I ever played with in my life, the band that Billy Eckstine had... They had Charlie Parker, Lucky Thompson, Dexter Gordon, Leo Parker... The trumpets, they had me and Dizzy

ctx.x: So Teddy Reig, he asked me whether I would mind making the date, and I said, "Sure, I'll be glad to" -- because I was glad to record with anybody during that stage. And we just played the tunes, man. It was such a happy affair, there was no problems, we didn't have no problems, because everybody was playing and everybody could take care of business. And Teddy Reig put the date together, and it turned out a very good date.
Like, Leo Parker had an original chart. And he said, "Maggie, would you make this record with me?" I said, "Oh,
